patch.value: Keep branch-only completions out of release tags that do not contain them

pm-cli PR 1228 closed four items on a feature branch before the daily v2026.9.10 tag was cut from main. pm-changelog 2026.9.9 places those items in the released 2026.9.10 window solely from completed_at even though their terminal item state is absent from the tag. Verify git tag membership in the package-owned CLI and extension, preserve explicit release attribution and non-git SDK inputs, and retain untagged work until an actual release contains it.

A branch closure preceding a main release remains Unreleased until a tag includes it; the first containing release owns it across future regenerations; explicit release metadata and non-git callers remain compatible; CLI and extension share the SDK implementation; real temporary Git fixtures and complete quality gates pass
